doc: Dash -> ability rows (DashFlow, docs/decisions/0010-dash-ability-flow.md). dash.<ground|air>.<lmb|rmb|e|x|q>: {mode: fire (mid-dash) | buffer (to the dash's end; the default for a missing row) | cancel (ends the dash), carry: dash momentum kept into it, variant: a dash-variant name the kit reads, source: what the source hero does}. into_dash.<slot>: the same for Shift pressed during that ability's wind-up or recovery. kit_owns: the dashes (ground, air) the kit runs in its own state, out of DashFlow's sight until it overrides ArchKit.in_dash(). Dredge's into_dash buffer rows are held by DredgeKit (dash_held) and barge the step the slam or the Broadside ends. Combo rows (docs/decisions/0015-combo-flow.md): jump.<slot> (a press mid-jump: fire | buffer to the landing), into_jump.<slot> (a jump in the ability's wind-up or recovery: fire | cancel | buffer | lock; into_dash takes the same modes and an optional air sub-row), hold.<slot>.<ground|air|jump|mantle> (a held slot through that move: keep | cancel). A missing row combines; any other row is an exception and carries a reason and a source.

lmb.source: Data: Brute Dash is a plain dash. Footage (493.2-493.6 s): a near-blink of about 0.12 s; he lands, turns back to the aim within 1 frame and fires and walks by 493.6 s. Ours: the shot goes the step the 0.18 s lunge ends.

rmb.source: Data: Abyssal Grasp has no dash lock. Footage: not shown from a dash. Ours: the arm is thrown from the lunge (its range counts from where he is).

e.source: Data: Primal Slam has no dash lock; the dash-into-slam close-in is the hero's engage. Footage: not shown from a dash. Ours: the planted wind-up starts at once and the lunge finishes under it.

x.source: Data: Slugwave has no dash lock. Footage: not shown from a dash. Ours: the charge starts at once (he walks slowly through it).

q.source: No source glove; it goes off from the lunge like his abilities.

lmb.source: Data: Brute Dash (Air) is its own slot, further. Footage: not shown. Ours: as on the ground, the shot goes as the pounce ends.

rmb.source: Data: no dash lock. Footage: not shown. Ours: the arm is thrown from the pounce, his height held while it is out (item 31).

e.source: Data: Primal Slam slams down (it pushes you down, never over the abyss). Owner note: in the air E is a straight-down smash; from the pounce it drops at once.

x.source: Data: no dash lock. Footage: not shown. Ours: the charge starts at once.

q.source: No source glove; it goes off from the pounce.

lmb.source: Footage: he walks and dashes between shots (0.5 s apart). Ours: the barge goes between shots.

rmb.source: Wiki fine print: only the dash and the air dash can be used while Abyssal Grasp pulls; data: the arm pierces terrain. Ours: the barge goes during the hook's flight and the reel, and the reel continues.

e.source: Footage (0221-0236): the slam is one committed 0.4 s beat, no dash out of it. Ours: Shift in the planted wind-up (or the air smash) is held and the barge goes the step the slam lands.

x.source: Footage (ult f22-f43): he stands through the charge and both waves, no dash out of it. Ours: Shift is held and the barge goes when the Broadside ends.

q.source: No source glove; the barge goes and the glove's effect stays.

rmb.source: Wiki fine print: only the dash and the air dash can be used while Abyssal Grasp pulls. Ours today (measured by --dash-flow-check): no jump while the hook reels (KitStatus grounded: 'reeling: no jump or glide').
